QUESTIONS & CARE

A little more clarity.

Product selection and care information from the original brochures.

Choosing a film

What is the difference between PPF and window film?

Paint protection film is applied to painted body panels. Automotive window film is applied to glazing for light and solar control. The two product lines serve different surfaces and purposes.

Source: PPF brochure pp. 16–27; window brochure pp. 5–11.
Can I choose a matte or black PPF?

Yes. The supplied catalogue includes T75M and A75M matte models, AT Super Black and AT Super Matte Black, alongside clear gloss products.

Source: PPF brochure pp. 16–27.
How do I compare window film specifications?

VLT describes visible light transmission. The brochure separately lists UV rejection, infrared rejection and total solar energy rejection (TSER). Compare the same metric across products; infrared rejection and TSER are different figures.

Source: Window brochure pp. 5, 7, 9, 11.
Do the vehicle photos show every exact TPU color?

No. The supplied photos illustrate the collection. Confirm a specific color or carbon effect with a physical sample before making a selection.

Source: TPU brochure pp. 28, 31; asset review.

Installation & care

How soon can I wash a vehicle after PPF installation?

The PPF brochure recommends avoiding contact with film edges for the first 3 days and washing approximately one week after installation once the film is fully dry. It also advises against brushes and abrasive cleaning materials.

Source: PPF brochure p. 39.
When can I clean newly installed window film?

The window film brochure says not to clean the film for at least 30 days after installation. Confirm the appropriate care instructions with your installer.

Source: Window brochure pp. 5, 7, 9, 11.
What should I know about color TPU installation?

The TPU brochure describes lightly wet installation for gloss material and dry application for matte material with an air-channel liner, with wet application possible on larger areas. The installer should confirm the method for the selected product.

Source: TPU brochure p. 21.

Product inquiries

Is overseas warranty coverage confirmed?

No. Periods shown on product pages are taken from the supplied Chinese brochures. Overseas coverage, local terms and installer eligibility need confirmation. Color PPF has additional conditions and a separate natural-fading period.

Source: PPF brochure p. 38; TPU brochure p. 31; window brochure specification tables.
Can I purchase film directly on this website?

This is a product catalogue for inquiries. Use the product inquiry form to prepare your requirements; no online purchase is available.

Source: Project scope.
